description: Calculate per-store and per-employee statistics for a generated monthly schedule. Pass the complete project object and either provide the generated schedule as the top-level "schedule" property or put it in the project schedules array. This operation is read-only and does not save data.

inputSchema.description: The complete Rotase project object. Use the object returned as the "project" field by rotase_examples as a template. Required top-level sections are project, store and employees; availability, preferences, monthlyTargets and schedules may be empty arrays when unused.

name: rotase_schedule_report
title: Create an employee schedule report
